Aisha: Heads-up: ran a 1h staging soak with long-context (>8k tokens) chat sessions. Observed steady KV memory growth ~120MB/hr and frequent eviction spikes coinciding with cross-request cache misses. Repro trace attached.

Ben: Can you paste the log snippet? are keys changing per request? last time we saw this it was tenant salt + ephemeral request id.

Aisha: snippet:
```
[2025-06-05T14:02:12Z] KV: insert key=tenant:123|prefix:conv:abc|session:session-xyz|req:9f8e (size 256KB)
[2025-06-05T14:02:13Z] KV: eviction start, freed 48MB
[2025-06-05T14:05:00Z] KV: miss for prefix:conv:abc session:session-zyx
```
Notice req id present in keys.

Carlos: confirmed from profiler (heap flame): allocation hotspots inside key-serialization path. High-cardinality suffixes (req id, transient meta) blow out residency. Also kernel shows paging thrashed around those times — compaction could not keep up.

Marta: Proposal: normalize cache keys to canonical prefix + optional sessionAffinity tag. Drop per-request nonce from stable key. Add small 30s ephemeral bucket for request-only items. Example:
```
key = hash(tenant|prefix|canonicalized_session)
request_only stored in request-bucket (TTL 30s)
```

Ben: How will this affect correctness? some models rely on per-request salts for safety (dedup).

Aisha: For model-level dedup we still include the nonce inside the value metadata, not the cache key. Cache lookup remains reusable across identical prefixes. Tests show hit-rate up from 18% -> 63% in soak when we canonicalize.

Jon: Ops note: need migration/rollout plan. We can't invalidate whole cache at once. Suggest canary: enable canonical keys on 10% of hosts + fallback to legacy lookup if miss. Collect hit/miss delta; auto rollback on error rate > 0.2%.

Marta: Also add metrics: kv.key_cardinality, kv.eviction_rate, kv.request_only_count, kv.prefetch_coalesced.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/kvcanonical/2025-06-06T02:00Z by @marta (dry-run).

Aisha: I'll run longctx soak on canary cluster after deploy and post perf graphs. Action: Aisha implement key-normalizer PR, Marta add metrics dashboard, Jon add rollout plan. :thumbsup:
